392554.label: Pet Rent
392554.tooltip_label: Monthly fee required per approved pet or apartment. Maximum two pets per apartment. Service Animals and ESAs are exempt. Contact the Leasing Team for additional details and weight specifications, if applicable.

392557.label: Utility - Sewer Service
392557.tooltip_label: Monthly fee for sewer utility service.

392564.label: Renter Provided Liability Insurance
392564.tooltip_label: Minimum personal liability coverage required by the Property. Contact the Leasing Team for details of specific requirements.

392567.label: Renters Liability Insurance - Property Program
392567.tooltip_label: Minimum personal liability coverage required by the Property if no Third Party policy is provided. Does not include contents coverage.

392568.label: Utility - Electric Service
392568.tooltip_label: Monthly fee for electric utility service.

392570.label: Utility - Cable TV Service
392570.tooltip_label: Monthly fee for cable TV service.

392572.label: Utility - Water Service
392572.tooltip_label: Monthly fee for water utility service.

392574.label: Amenity Fee - First Lease
392574.tooltip_label: A per lease charge for access to amenities at move-in. Typically charged per apartment but may be per person. Contact the Leasing Team for further clarification.

392578.label: Security Deposit - Standard
392578.tooltip_label: Refundable deposit required at move-in. Applications that are Conditionally Approved (i.e. income and/or credit-related reasons) may require a larger security deposit and/or last month's rent deposit (each not to exceed a full month's base rent).

392579.label: Third Party Pre-Screening Fee
392579.tooltip_label: A non-refundable fee due at the time of application. Per applicant.

514366.label: Parking - Reserved
514366.tooltip_label: Monthly fee per reserved parking space. Pricing may vary based on size, location, and/or number of spaces rented. All vehicles must be registered with the Management Office. Contact the Leasing Team for availability and limitations.

922065.label: Pet Deposit (refundable)
922065.tooltip_label: A one-time refundable deposit required per approved pet or apartment. Maximum two pets per apartment. Service Animals and ESAs are exempt. Contact the Leasing Team for additional details and weight specifications, if applicable.
